# Subway Seat for Helix

Copy the themes to `~/.config/helix/themes/`. To follow the terminal's light or dark mode, use `[theme]` with `dark = "subway_seat"` and `light = "subway_seat_enamel"`.

[Helix](https://helix-editor.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/helix/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway_seat.toml`](subway_seat.toml) | ~/.config/helix/themes/subway_seat.toml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway_seat_tunnel.toml`](subway_seat_tunnel.toml) | ~/.config/helix/themes/subway_seat_tunnel.toml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway_seat_enamel.toml`](subway_seat_enamel.toml) | ~/.config/helix/themes/subway_seat_enamel.toml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/helix/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway_seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/helix/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway_seat_tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/helix/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway_seat_enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
